exact_statement: Refinement of A022 ledger v9, whose stated scopes are retained. For ANY Boolean DATA seed b on k>=1 bits, ANY adjacent vertices v,w, and ANY dependent Boolean controllers a,c_raw on the SAME independent m-bit cube, put delta=2^-k, epsilon=b(v)b(w), c=epsilon*c_raw, h(y,z)=a(z) if y=0 else c(z), V=U-phi(mean^2), J_y=p_h({y})log2(pi_h({y})/p_h({y})), R=Delta_yV(h)-J_y. Let E(F) be the NONEMPTY DATA/empty CONTROL upper-set contribution. Exactly: V(F)=E(F)+delta[V(a)+V(c)]+2delta R+delta(k-1)[Var(a)+Var(c)]/2 and G_z V(F)=delta[GV(a)+GV(c)]+2delta G_zR+delta(k-1)[W1(a)+W1(c)]/2+G_zE(F). Both physical outcomes and the singleton term are retained. R>=0 and G_zR<=0 are FALSE in general: two-bit masks(1,8) give R=-1/2,G_zR=-3/2; masks(0,1) give R=3/16,G_zR=1/8. For actual m-bit point defect a_m=-1 only0,c=1, r=2^-m, R=r-r^2 and G_zR=mr^2>0, every m>=1. For antipodal point-positive a,c, R=-2r+4r^2*1_modd and G_zR=m[-4r+4r^2(1+1_modd)], while actual selector influence d=2r; hence |G_zR|/d=2m-2mr(1+1_modd) is unbounded. This refutes only absolute interference payment by selector disagreement, NOT signed GU or FEI. All256 ordered two-bit pairs are exactly classified: R signs176positive/24negative/56zero; G_zR168positive/48negative/40zero. Combined signed residual (7), arbitrary adjacent stable GU payment and universal FEI remain OPEN. Also EVERY antipodal-mux coordinate has Delta_iV=R, hence GV(h)=(m+1)R<0 for m>=2. For the actual g tensor2 seed, flipping vertices0 and1 produces EXACTLY28 zero Fourier rows from a seed with full Fourier support: hat f(S)=hat b(S)-(1/16)*1_{first coordinate in S}; zero iff first coordinate lies in S and its second block is nonempty. Thus the former relative amplitude<=1/2 argument cannot be reused at this t2 corner. This does not refute the signed adjacent GU inequality.
